data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'renatus', meaning 'reborn'. Parents who choose Renato usually hope their child will grow to embody reborn and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: Renato is an Italian name, so it is most commonly used in Italian culture. In Italian-speaking communities, the name Renato is considered to be a strong and masculine name. It is often given to babies born during the rough winter months as a symbol of new life and hope.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Renato holds deep spiritual meaning. Renato is a reminder of the process of spiritual rebirth and renewal that believers undergo in their faith journey. It is a testament to the idea that even in the midst of darkness and adversity, one can be reborn and rise up to become a child of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Renato, meaning "reborn" in Italian, symbolizes new beginnings and the spiritual transformation experienced through the act of baptism in Christianity. It is a reminder of the promise to live a life rooted in God's love and grace.
